comparison_label: equal-update/equal-data primary comparison under a common capped inference budget; realized training and inference FLOPs are measured and are not assumed equal

primary_analysis.checkpoint_selection: the checkpoint after exactly 2000 optimizer updates; no validation-based selection
primary_analysis.paired_unit: one seed-level accuracy delta after deterministic within-seed aggregation
primary_analysis.evaluation_policy: final-depth inference at the maximum registered macro depth that remains within the common 200000000-FLOP cap; fixed depth remains four blocks; hierarchical micro depth is one
primary_analysis.family_aggregation: compute accuracy within each family first; pooled accuracy is the unweighted arithmetic mean of the three family accuracies within each seed
primary_analysis.depth_aggregation: no aggregation across depths for the primary claim; final-depth inference at the maximum feasible registered depth is primary and every other registered depth is a separately reported robustness curve

multiple_comparisons.family_superiority_family: six OOD hypotheses: flat-minus-fixed and hierarchy-minus-fixed in each of three task families
multiple_comparisons.id_noninferiority_family: two pooled ID hypotheses, one per recurrent arm versus fixed
multiple_comparisons.protected_region_family: eight hypotheses: two recurrent arms by four protected regions; within each seed and region, ID and OOD correct/example counts are micro-aggregated before the paired delta

noninferiority.rule: the Holm-adjusted one-sided lower bound on candidate-minus-reference accuracy must be at least the registered negative margin

secondary_compute_normalized_control.training: compare deterministic learning-curve checkpoints at the greatest cumulative realized training FLOPs not exceeding the smallest final-arm training FLOP total; never interpolate accuracy and never substitute examples or seeds
secondary_compute_normalized_control.inference: for every seed/family/split, compare the deepest recorded arm position whose cumulative realized inference FLOPs do not exceed the fixed-depth primary realized FLOPs; unused FLOPs remain recorded
secondary_compute_normalized_control.tie_break: choose the shallower checkpoint or depth when realized FLOPs tie
secondary_compute_normalized_control.interpretation: a primary gain absent from this control is classified as training-compute scaling, test-time scaling, or both; it is not architectural efficiency

adaptive_halting_analysis.readout_accounting: both modes execute and account for a decoder/residual readout at every recurrent position
adaptive_halting_analysis.maximum_depth: largest registered depth whose per-position readouts remain within the common FLOP cap
adaptive_halting_analysis.separation_from_primary: adaptive halting is a registered control analysis; it is not the primary final-depth accuracy policy

compute_accounting.estimated_training_flops: pre-run sum over the complete frozen schedule
compute_accounting.realized_training_flops: sum only over optimizer updates that completed successfully
compute_accounting.estimated_inference_flops: pre-execution analytical count for the requested policy
compute_accounting.realized_inference_flops: sum only over recurrent positions and readouts actually executed
compute_accounting.training_formula: batch_size * 3 * differentiable_forward_flops + 17 * trainable_parameters per completed AdamW update; the parameter term includes AdamW, clipping, and deterministic state-layout canonicalization
compute_accounting.caveat: analytical operation counts are deterministic architecture-level FLOPs, not device-profiler or wall-clock measurements

checkpoint_and_failure_semantics.resume_validity: valid only from a hash-verified checkpoint with identical run, arm, seed, model, config, split, schedule, and next-update identities
checkpoint_and_failure_semantics.random_state: model initialization is reset from the paired seed; schedules and recurrent initial states use recorded deterministic seeds; no unrecorded stochastic operation is permitted
checkpoint_and_failure_semantics.failed_seed: retry only the same seed from its latest valid checkpoint; never substitute a seed
checkpoint_and_failure_semantics.nan_or_nonfinite: mark INVALID and preserve the checkpoint and failure journal
checkpoint_and_failure_semantics.memory_exhaustion_or_process_interruptio: mark INCOMPLETE; resume is allowed only under the resume-validity rule
checkpoint_and_failure_semantics.incomplete_evaluation: mark INCOMPLETE; never impute zero and never omit the seed from an aggregate
checkpoint_and_failure_semantics.code_or_contract_hash_change: mark INVALID and require a new versioned run

scope: Milestone 3 recurrent comparison only; neural memory, MoE, adapters, consolidation, and self-improvement remain prohibited
